controles.affirmation: Toute la croissance vient d'une acquisition endettee, pas d'une amelioration de la rentabilite (hook) ; la totalite de la croissance du CA vient de la consolidation de PA Consulting et de la progression du segment I&AF
controles.verbatim_source: Revenue increases for both the three and nine month periods year over year were mainly driven by the Company's I&AF business ... The I&AF segment benefited primarily from stronger performance in our Global Operations, International and Americas sectors ... Since the March 2, 2021 investment date, PA Consulting has been accounted for as a consolidated subsidiary and as a separate operating segment of the Company. Segments T3 : I&AF 3,746,900 (contre 2,699,062) ; PA Consulting 329,510 (contre 332,706).
controles.correction_proposee: PA Consulting etait deja consolide depuis mars 2021 : l'operation de mars 2026 est un rachat des actions restantes, pas une nouvelle consolidation, et son chiffre d'affaires recule de 1,0%. La totalite de la hausse de 1 044,6 M$ vient du coeur historique I&AF (+1 047,8 M$), tire par les activites Global Operations, International et Americas. Formulation correcte : la croissance vient du metier historique, tandis que l'operation financiere sur PA Consulting pese sur le resultat par action.

controles.affirmation: La hausse de 60% de la dette vient de deux nouveaux prets a terme de 700 M$ (3 ans) et 500 M$ (5 ans) emis en 2026 pour financer le rachat des actions PA Consulting restantes
controles.verbatim_source: 2026 Term Loan Facility - Three-year 700,000 ; 2026 Term Loan Facility - Five-year 500,000 ; 5.375% Bonds, due 2036 500,000 (contre 0) ; 4.75% Bonds, due 2031 800,000 (contre 0) ; Revolving Credit Facility 0 (contre 395,000) ; 2025 Term Loan Facility - USD 0 (contre 200,000) ; 2025 Term Loan Facility - GBP 0 (contre 550,261)
controles.correction_proposee: Enumeration incomplete : s'ajoutent 1 300 M$ de nouvelles obligations (500 M$ a 5,375% echeance 2036 et 800 M$ a 4,75% echeance 2031), tandis que 1 145,3 M$ d'anciennes lignes ont ete rembourses. Sans les obligations, l'arithmetique du +60% ne tient pas.

controles.affirmation: Glossaire : 'Dette long terme nette = dette a long terme diminuee de la tresorerie disponible' ; libelle 'dette long terme nette de 3 579,4 M$'
controles.verbatim_source: Less: Deferred Financing Fees (20,624) | (8,805) ; Total Long-term debt, net $3,579,376 $2,236,456. Bilan : Cash and cash equivalents $1,172,914 (contre $1,235,448).
controles.correction_proposee: Le 'net' du filing signifie net des frais d'emission differes, pas net de tresorerie. Dette brute 3 600,0 M$, tresorerie 1 172,9 M$, donc dette nette de tresorerie d'environ 2 406,5 M$ contre 1 001,0 M$ neuf mois plus tot. Definition du glossaire a corriger.

controles.affirmation: Le bond du taux d'impot est entierement lie aux 47,0 M$ de charges non deductibles associees a la transaction PA Consulting sur les neuf mois
controles.verbatim_source: Significant items contributing to the difference between the statutory U.S. federal corporate tax rate of 21.0% and the Company's effective tax rate for the nine-month period ended June 26, 2026 included unfavorable tax impacts of $47.0 million of non-deductible expenses associated with the PA Consulting Transaction on March 20, 2026, $12.7 million of U.S. state income taxes and $9.0 million of U.S. tax on foreign earnings.
controles.correction_proposee: Le filing cite trois postes, pas un seul : 47,0 M$ de charges non deductibles, 12,7 M$ d'impots d'Etats et 9,0 M$ d'impot americain sur les benefices etrangers. Remplacer 'entierement lie' par 'principalement lie'.

controles.verbatim_source: The Company's effective tax rates from continuing operations for the three months ended June 26, 2026 and June 27, 2025 were 43.4% and 21.9%, respectively ... included $35.8 million of non-deductible expenses associated with the PA Consulting Transaction ...
